changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Remove income enums that have no defensible monetary meaning and require every future vote income bucket to carry a consistent immutable profile and band identity.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE votes SET characteristic_snapshot = characteristic_snapshot - 'personalIncomeRange' - 'personalIncome' WHERE ( characteristic_snapshot ->> 'personalIncomeRange' IS NOT NULL OR characteristic_snapshot -> 'personalIncome' IS NOT NULL ) AND NOT COALESCE( (characteristic_snapshot ->> 'personalIncomeRange') ~ '^income\|[A-Z]{2,3}-[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z0-9-]+-v[1-9][0-9]*\|PERSONAL\|PERSONAL_TIER_[1-7]$' AND jsonb_typeof(characteristic_snapshot -> 'personalIncome') = 'object' AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,answerVersion}' = '2' AND (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,profileVersion}') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$' AND (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,marketCode}') ~ '^[A-Z]{2,3}$' AND (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,currencyCode}') ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,profileId}' ~ ( '^' || (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,marketCode}') || '-' || (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,currencyCode}') || '-' ) AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,measure}' = 'PERSONAL' AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,bandId}' ~ '^PERSONAL_TIER_[1-7]$' AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,relativeTier}' ~ '^TIER_[1-7]$' AND characteristic_snapshot ->> 'personalIncomeRange' = 'income|' || (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,profileId}') || '|PERSONAL|' || (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,bandId}') AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,bandId}' = 'PERSONAL_' || (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,relativeTier}'), false );
UPDATE votes SET characteristic_snapshot = characteristic_snapshot - 'householdIncomeRange' - 'householdIncome' WHERE ( characteristic_snapshot ->> 'householdIncomeRange' IS NOT NULL OR characteristic_snapshot -> 'householdIncome' IS NOT NULL ) AND NOT COALESCE( (characteristic_snapshot ->> 'householdIncomeRange') ~ '^income\|[A-Z]{2,3}-[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z0-9-]+-v[1-9][0-9]*\|HOUSEHOLD\|HOUSEHOLD_TIER_[1-7]$' AND jsonb_typeof(characteristic_snapshot -> 'householdIncome') = 'object' AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,answerVersion}' = '2' AND (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,profileVersion}') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$' AND (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,marketCode}') ~ '^[A-Z]{2,3}$' AND (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,currencyCode}') ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,profileId}' ~ ( '^' || (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,marketCode}') || '-' || (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,currencyCode}') || '-' ) AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,measure}' = 'HOUSEHOLD' AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,bandId}' ~ '^HOUSEHOLD_TIER_[1-7]$' AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,relativeTier}' ~ '^TIER_[1-7]$' AND characteristic_snapshot ->> 'householdIncomeRange' = 'income|' || (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,profileId}') || '|HOUSEHOLD|' || (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,bandId}') AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,bandId}' = 'HOUSEHOLD_' || (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,relativeTier}'), false );

ALTER TABLE votes ADD CONSTRAINT chk_votes_personal_income_snapshot_versioned CHECK ( ( characteristic_snapshot ->> 'personalIncomeRange' IS NULL AND characteristic_snapshot -> 'personalIncome' IS NULL ) OR ( (characteristic_snapshot ->> 'personalIncomeRange') ~ '^income\|[A-Z]{2,3}-[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z0-9-]+-v[1-9][0-9]*\|PERSONAL\|PERSONAL_TIER_[1-7]$' AND jsonb_typeof(characteristic_snapshot -> 'personalIncome') = 'object' AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,answerVersion}' = '2' AND (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,profileVersion}') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$' AND (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,marketCode}') ~ '^[A-Z]{2,3}$' AND (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,currencyCode}') ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,profileId}' ~ ( '^' || (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,marketCode}') || '-' || (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,currencyCode}') || '-' ) AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,measure}' = 'PERSONAL' AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,bandId}' ~ '^PERSONAL_TIER_[1-7]$' AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,relativeTier}' ~ '^TIER_[1-7]$' AND characteristic_snapshot ->> 'personalIncomeRange' = 'income|' || (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,profileId}') || '|PERSONAL|' || (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,bandId}') AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,bandId}' = 'PERSONAL_' || (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{personalIncome,relativeTier}') ) );
ALTER TABLE votes ADD CONSTRAINT chk_votes_household_income_snapshot_versioned CHECK ( ( characteristic_snapshot ->> 'householdIncomeRange' IS NULL AND characteristic_snapshot -> 'householdIncome' IS NULL ) OR ( (characteristic_snapshot ->> 'householdIncomeRange') ~ '^income\|[A-Z]{2,3}-[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z0-9-]+-v[1-9][0-9]*\|HOUSEHOLD\|HOUSEHOLD_TIER_[1-7]$' AND jsonb_typeof(characteristic_snapshot -> 'householdIncome') = 'object' AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,answerVersion}' = '2' AND (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,profileVersion}') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$' AND (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,marketCode}') ~ '^[A-Z]{2,3}$' AND (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,currencyCode}') ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,profileId}' ~ ( '^' || (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,marketCode}') || '-' || (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,currencyCode}') || '-' ) AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,measure}' = 'HOUSEHOLD' AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,bandId}' ~ '^HOUSEHOLD_TIER_[1-7]$' AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,relativeTier}' ~ '^TIER_[1-7]$' AND characteristic_snapshot ->> 'householdIncomeRange' = 'income|' || (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,profileId}') || '|HOUSEHOLD|' || (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,bandId}') AND characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,bandId}' = 'HOUSEHOLD_' || (characteristic_snapshot #>> '{householdIncome,relativeTier}') ) );

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE votes DROP CONSTRAINT chk_votes_household_income_snapshot_versioned; ALTER TABLE votes DROP CONSTRAINT chk_votes_personal_income_snapshot_versioned;
